sicm-harmonic.label: Harmonic-oscillator Lagrange residual
sicm-harmonic.source:
(do
  (require '[emmy.env :as e])
  (defn L-harmonic [m k]
    (fn [local]
      (let [q (e/coordinate local)
            v (e/velocity local)]
        (e/- (e/* (e// 1 2) m (e/square v))
             (e/* (e// 1 2) k (e/square q))))))
  (e/simplify
   (((e/Lagrange-equations (L-harmonic 1 1)) e/cos) 't)))

sicm-figure-1-1.label: Figure 1.1: stationary path maximum error
sicm-figure-1-1.source:
(do
  (require '[emmy.env :as e])
  (defn sicm-L-harmonic [m k]
    (fn [local]
      (let [q (e/coordinate local)
            v (e/velocity local)]
        (e/- (e/* (e// 1 2) m (e/square v))
             (e/* (e// 1 2) k (e/square q))))))
  (def sicm-q3
    (e/find-path (sicm-L-harmonic 1.0 1.0)
                 0.0 1.0 1.5707963267948966 0.0 3))
  (apply max
         (map (fn [i]
                (let [t (* i 0.01)]
                  (js/Math.abs (- (sicm-q3 t) (js/Math.cos t)))))
              (range 158))))
